newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom to announce price Nov 17 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Telekom to announce price Nov 17 - paper.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Telekom AG will announce the price of its major initial public share offering on November 17, Die Welt newspaper said on Friday, quoting an internal company document.

The schedule for the communications giant's float has now been finalised, with the final issue prospectus due for release on October 4. Small investors will be entitled to register to subscribe for shares until October 11, the newspaper added.
The price range for the offering will be set on October 22.
First listing of the shares will be on Wall Street and in Frankfurt on November 18.

Telekom's partial privatisation, Germany's largest to date, will take place through a capital increase to which the state will not subscribe. It is expected to raise up to 15 billion marks ($9.8 billion) over two tranches.
